alternatives.quote:
• Low-Level Retrieval. This level is primar- ily focused on retrieving specific entities along with their associated attributes or relationships. Queries at this level are detail-oriented and aim to extract precise information about particular nodes or edges within the graph.

• High-Level Retrieval. This level addresses broader topics and overarching themes. Queries at this level aggregate information across mul- tiple related entities and relationships, provid- ing insights into higher-level concepts and sum- maries rather than specific details.

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote:
• (i) Query Keyword Extraction. For a given query q, the retrieval algorithm of LightRAG begins by extracting both local query keywords k(l) and global query keywords k(g).

• (ii) Keyword Matching. The algorithm uses an efficient vector database to match local query key- words with candidate entities and global query keywords with relations linked to global keys.

• (iii) Incorporating High-Order Relatedness. To enhance the query with higher-order relat- edness, LightRAGfurther gathers neighboring nodes within the local subgraphs of the retrieved graph elements. This process involves the set {vi|vi ∈V ∧(vi ∈Nv ∨vi ∈Ne)}, where Nv and Ne represent the one-hop neighboring nodes of the retrieved nodes v and edges e, respectively.

reference_answer: QASPER 共 5,049 问、1,585 篇 NLP 论文；提问者只读标题和摘要，另一组 NLP 从业者读全文作答并给出证据。QASPER 证据可为文本、表格、图片；55.5% 的问题需要多段证据，13% 需要表格或图片。SciDQA 共 2,937 问答对，问题来自领域专家的同行评审，答案来自论文作者。SciDQA 经人工专家编辑与标注，但因为标注成本高，只为数据集的一个子集提供证据。

alternatives.title: A Dataset of Information-Seeking Questions and Answers Anchored in Research Papers
alternatives.quote: We therefore present QASPER, a dataset of 5,049 questions over 1,585 Natu- ral Language Processing papers. Each ques- tion is written by an NLP practitioner who read only the title and abstract of the corre- sponding paper, and the question seeks infor- mation present in the full text. The questions are then answered by a separate set of NLP practitioners who also provide supporting ev- idence to answers.

evidence_units.answer_point: QASPER 证据可为文本、表格、图片；55.5% 的问题需要多段证据，13% 需要表格或图片。

alternatives.title: A Dataset of Information-Seeking Questions and Answers Anchored in Research Papers
alternatives.quote: In addition to pro- viding answers when the questions are answerable, the annotators were asked to select text, tables, or ﬁgures as evidence required for answering the ques- tions. 55.5% of the questions require evidence from multiple paragraphs in the paper and 13% require tables or ﬁgures.

evidence_units.answer_point: SciDQA 共 2,937 问答对，问题来自领域专家的同行评审，答案来自论文作者。

question: LightRAG 与 GRAG 都利用图结构，具体检索对象与回答组织方式是否相同？
question_en: Do LightRAG and GRAG retrieve the same graph objects and organize information for generation in the same way?
reference_answer: LightRAG 低层检索特定实体及属性、关系；高层聚合多个相关实体与关系，面向主题与全局概念。LightRAG 提取局部与全局关键词，向量匹配实体与关系，并补充检索元素的一跳邻居。LightRAG 将相关实体与关系的名称、描述、原文片段等文本整合进 LLM 上下文生成答案。GRAG 先检索相关 ego-graphs，再以 graph soft pruning 精炼并合并，近似寻找相关文本子图，避免穷举。GRAG 同时输入硬提示（层次化文本图描述）与软提示（图编码器产生的图 token），保留文本和拓扑信息。

required_answer_points.text: LightRAG 低层检索特定实体及属性、关系；高层聚合多个相关实体与关系，面向主题与全局概念。
LightRAG 提取局部与全局关键词，向量匹配实体与关系，并补充检索元素的一跳邻居。
LightRAG 将相关实体与关系的名称、描述、原文片段等文本整合进 LLM 上下文生成答案。
GRAG 先检索相关 ego-graphs，再以 graph soft pruning 精炼并合并，近似寻找相关文本子图，避免穷举。
GRAG 同时输入硬提示（层次化文本图描述）与软提示（图编码器产生的图 token），保留文本和拓扑信息。

evidence_units.answer_point: LightRAG 低层检索特定实体及属性、关系；高层聚合多个相关实体与关系，面向主题与全局概念。

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote:
• Low-Level Retrieval. This level is primar- ily focused on retrieving specific entities along with their associated attributes or relationships. Queries at this level are detail-oriented and aim to extract precise information about particular nodes or edges within the graph.

• High-Level Retrieval. This level addresses broader topics and overarching themes. Queries at this level aggregate information across mul- tiple related entities and relationships, provid- ing insights into higher-level concepts and sum- maries rather than specific details.

evidence_units.answer_point: LightRAG 提取局部与全局关键词，向量匹配实体与关系，并补充检索元素的一跳邻居。

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote:
• (i) Query Keyword Extraction. For a given query q, the retrieval algorithm of LightRAG begins by extracting both local query keywords k(l) and global query keywords k(g).

• (ii) Keyword Matching. The algorithm uses an efficient vector database to match local query key- words with candidate entities and global query keywords with relations linked to global keys.

• (iii) Incorporating High-Order Relatedness. To enhance the query with higher-order relat- edness, LightRAGfurther gathers neighboring nodes within the local subgraphs of the retrieved graph elements. This process involves the set {vi|vi ∈V ∧(vi ∈Nv ∨vi ∈Ne)}, where Nv and Ne represent the one-hop neighboring nodes of the retrieved nodes v and edges e, respectively.

evidence_units.answer_point: LightRAG 将相关实体与关系的名称、描述、原文片段等文本整合进 LLM 上下文生成答案。

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote: Utilization of Retrieved Information. Utilizing the retrieved information ψ(q; ˆD), our LightRAG employs a general-purpose LLM to generate an- swers based on the collected data. This data com- prises concatenated values V from relevant entities and relations, produced by the profiling function P(·). It includes names, descriptions of entities and relations, and excerpts from the original text. Context Integration and Answer Generation. By unifying the query with this multi-source text, the LLM generates informative answers tailored to the user’s needs, ensuring alignment with the query’s intent. This approach streamlines the an- swer generation process by integrating both context and query into the LLM model, as illustrated in de- tailed examples (Appendix 9.3).

evidence_units.answer_point: GRAG 先检索相关 ego-graphs，再以 graph soft pruning 精炼并合并，近似寻找相关文本子图，避免穷举。

alternatives.title: GRAG: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote: Specifically, to achieve efficient textual subgraph retrieval, we propose a new divide-and-conquer strategy that breaks the high-dimensional combinatorial opti- mization problem into first retrieving the most relevant ego-graphs and then refining and union- ing them with a graph soft pruning mechanism. This provides an approximate solution to identify- ing the most relevant textual subgraph structure, thereby avoiding the NP-hard problem of exhaus- tively searching all subgraphs (Johnson and Garey, 1979).

evidence_units.answer_point: GRAG 同时输入硬提示（层次化文本图描述）与软提示（图编码器产生的图 token），保留文本和拓扑信息。

alternatives.title: GRAG: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote: To integrate the retrieved textual subgraphs into LLMs, we feed the LLM both text view via hard prompts (text tokens) and graph view via soft prompts (graph tokens). Retrieved textual sub- graphs are transformed into hierarchical text de- scriptions by our proposed graph algorithms to form hard prompts, which encode the topological information in texts. Soft prompts are generated by encoding the graph’s topological information directly via graph encoders, encoding text informa- tion as node/edge attributes in graphs.

question: 能否仅凭论文各自报告的分数断言 LightRAG 全面优于 LongRAG？请检查数据集、模型与指标条件。
question_en: Can the papers' reported scores alone establish that LightRAG universally outperforms LongRAG: A Dual-Perspective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm for Long-Context Question Answering? Examine datasets, models, and metrics.
reference_answer: LightRAG 在 UltraDomain 的 Agriculture、CS、Legal、Mixed 上实验，以 LLM 评判全面性、多样性、赋能性及 Overall。LightRAG 默认所有 LLM 操作使用 GPT-4o-mini；比较两份答案并计算胜率，非同一基准上的答案 F1。这篇 LongRAG 在 LongBench 的 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MusiQue 上报告 F1；模型包括带 SFT 的开源模型及未 SFT 的 GPT-3.5、GLM-4 等。不能据此断言全面优于；需在相同数据、模型、预算和指标下作受控比较。

required_answer_points.text: LightRAG 在 UltraDomain 的 Agriculture、CS、Legal、Mixed 上实验，以 LLM 评判全面性、多样性、赋能性及 Overall。
LightRAG 默认所有 LLM 操作使用 GPT-4o-mini；比较两份答案并计算胜率，非同一基准上的答案 F1。
这篇 LongRAG 在 LongBench 的 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MusiQue 上报告 F1；模型包括带 SFT 的开源模型及未 SFT 的 GPT-3.5、GLM-4 等。
实验条件与指标不同，不能直接比较分数或推出普遍优势。

evidence_units.answer_point: LightRAG 在 UltraDomain 的 Agriculture、CS、Legal、Mixed 上实验，以 LLM 评判全面性、多样性、赋能性及 Overall。

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote: To evaluate the effectiveness of LightRAG, we con- ducted experiments on four datasets from the Ultra- Domain benchmark (Qian et al., 2024), covering diverse domains such as Agriculture, CS, Legal, and Mixed. Each dataset ranges from 600,000 to 5,000,000 tokens. We compare LightRAG with state-of-the-art RAG methods, including Naive RAG, RQ-RAG, HyDE, and GraphRAG. Using a robust LLM-based evaluation, we assess perfor- mance across four dimensions: Comprehensive- ness, Diversity, Empowerment, and Overall.

evidence_units.answer_point: LightRAG 默认所有 LLM 操作使用 GPT-4o-mini；比较两份答案并计算胜率，非同一基准上的答案 F1。

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote: For all LLM-based operations in LightRAG, we de- fault to using GPT-4o-mini.

alternatives.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
alternatives.quote: The LLM directly compares two answers for each dimension and selects the superior response for each criterion. After identifying the winning an- swer for the three dimensions, the LLM combines the results to determine the overall better answer. To ensure a fair evaluation and mitigate the poten- tial bias that could arise from the order in which the answers are presented in the prompt, we alternate the placement of each answer. We calculate win rates accordingly, leading to the final results.

evidence_units.answer_point: 这篇 LongRAG 在 LongBench 的 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MusiQue 上报告 F1；模型包括带 SFT 的开源模型及未 SFT 的 GPT-3.5、GLM-4 等。

alternatives.title: LongRAG: A Dual-Perspective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm for Long-Context Question Answering
alternatives.quote: Datasets & Evaluation. We select three chal- lenging multi-hop datasets – HotpotQA, 2Wiki- MultiHopQA (2WikiMQA), and MusiQue – from the Longbench (Bai et al., 2023b) for evaluation, rather than using raw datasets. We standardize these data to adapt to RAG tasks (more details in Appendix B.2), and report the F1-score as eval- uation metrics for all three datasets.

alternatives.title: LongRAG: A Dual-Perspective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigm for Long-Context Question Answering

question: SCITAT 为什么需要同时理解科学表格和正文？QASPER 的纯文本评估能否完整覆盖这种能力？
question_en: Why does SCITAT require scientific tables and text together, and can QASPER's original text-only evaluation fully cover that ability?
reference_answer: SCITAT 强调表格与正文的联系：只分开处理会漏掉关联信息，问题尽可能同时涉及二者。QASPER 证据可为文本、表格、图片；55.5% 的问题需要多段证据，13% 需要表格或图片。QASPER 论文的文本实验忽略需要图表作为证据的 13% 问题，并将多模态 QA 留给后续工作；不能代表完整图表能力。

alternatives.quote: Secondly, prior works focus only on split text and tables, overlooking the relevance between tables and text, thereby limiting their applicability (Wang et al., 2022). To address the limitations, in this paper: (i) We introduce a new SQA benchmark, covering diverse real-scenery reasoning types and consider- ing tables and text simultaneously.

alternatives.quote: To ensure the questions require reasoning on both tables and text, we require questions to involve tables and text as much as possible.

We leave multimodal question an- swering to future work.
